purpose: Assess GHS-OBAT building-height availability and geographic consistency for Italy before any 3D morphology, SVF or shading computation.
source: European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC), Global Human Settlement Layer
height_source: GHS-BUILT-H R2023A Average of Net Building Height (ANBH)
height_method: Mean height derived by zonal statistics from GHS-BUILT-H grid cells intersecting each Overture building footprint.
geometry_in_this_distribution: No building footprint polygons. CSV includes footprint centroids as lon/lat and GERS id.
footprint_geometry_source_if_later_requi: Overture Buildings release 2024-07-22.0, linked through GERS id.
qc_warnings: Numero di ADM1 trovato = 21; verificare la corrispondenza con le 20 regioni italiane.
important_limitation: The height attribute is not an observed building-by-building LiDAR measurement. It is transferred to footprint level from the GHS-BUILT-H gridded height product. Suitability for national morphology analysis must therefore be assessed before use.
